description: Service vélo sur le territoire de Saint-Nazaire Agglo is a dataset listed in Saint-Nazaire Agglo - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CARENE. Services vélo sur le territoire de Saint Nazaire Agglomération - la CARENE (Trignac, Besné, La Chapelle-des-Marais, Donges, Montoir-de-Bretagne, Pornichet, Saint-André-des-Eaux, Saint-Joachim, Saint-Malo-de-Guersac, Saint-Nazaire). Coverage: Saint-Nazaire Agglomération (Loire-Atlantique). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are velo. The portal shows 37 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-saintnazaireagglo-fr-portal.
